title: Principal Brand Designer
description:
### **About the Role**



At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.



Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands\-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.



Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high\-quality execution across the organisation.



You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.



### **What you'll own**

### **Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem**



Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.


* Group\-wide brand identity systems and visual standards
* Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles
* Multi\-brand design systems and asset libraries
* Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)
* Long\-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

### **Build scalable creative systems powered by AI**



You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI\-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high\-quality work consistently and efficiently.



Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.



You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

  

### **Raise the creative standard across OLX Group**



As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.



You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands\-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

  

### **Translate strategy into brand experiences**



You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.



You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long\-term brand value.

  

### **Drive adoption and influence across the organisation**



Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.



You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.



You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision\-making.

  

### **Mentor and elevate the craft**



As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.



You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

### **What we're looking for**


We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.


**You create brands that people trust**



Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.


**You think in systems**

You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.


**You bring strategy to life through Design**



You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.


**You're fluent in AI\-enabled Design**



You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.  

You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.


**You influence without authority**



You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.


**You bring depth of experience**



You'll likely have:


* 10\+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design
* Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets
* Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite
* Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences
* Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems
* Deep familiarity with AI\-powered creative tools and workflows
* Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

### **Why join OLX**



OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.



As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high\-quality brand experiences at scale.



This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.



If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI\-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.


### **Hiring Process**

We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:

**First Stage**
  

**Portfolio \& Design Leadership**
  

This is a 90\-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.  

  

**Second Stage**
  

**Multi\-Brand Systems \& Creative Leadership**
  

In this 60\-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi\-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.
  

**Third Stage**
  

**Executive Partnership \& Business Impact**
  

This 45\-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.  

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX**
OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements \- you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

**Data Process Policy**

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

title: Head of Brand
description:
**About Click\&Boat**
---------------------


Click\&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest\-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling \& renting boats easy.


Click\&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals, with over €170M in annual GMV and a community of 2\.4M\+ registered users across 150\+ countries worldwide. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the globe, from a day trip to a week\-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.


Performance marketing and SEO have been central to our growth. We are now investing in the next source of advantage: making Click\&Boat the brand travellers know, trust and actively seek out before they reach their destination.


A large share of boat rental still happens offline, locally and at the last minute. Our opportunity is to bring more of that demand online and encourage travellers to discover, plan and book their boating experience earlier. A fresh rebranding was performed in 2025, and the next challenge is now to build familiarity, trust and category authority at greater scale \- particularly for families, skippered rentals, multi\-day experiences and other higher\-consideration occasions.


To fuel this next phase of growth, we're hiring a Head of Brand \& Content to lead our brand strategy and build Click\&Boat into the most trusted and top\-of\-mind digital destination for boat rental, based in our Barcelona office.

**The role**
------------


We're looking for a Head of Brand \& Content to join our crew in Barcelona and lead a creative, highly motivated brand function with a solid leadership foundation. While driven by commercial impact, this is a strategic 360° brand position \- not an operational SEO or pure content role. It combines long\-term brand strategy, 360° activations (field/IRL, PR, social, brand partnerships) and multi\-channel orchestration to drive top\-of\-mind awareness and generate measurable unpaid demand.


Reporting directly to the General Manager of Click\&Boat, you will lead a team of 7 (4 permanent positions and 3 interns/apprentices) covering Digital Campaigns, Partnerships, Social Media, Influence, PR, and Content.


As a long\-term strategic leader, your role is to guide, frame, and validate the overall brand roadmap, while empowering your team of specialists to own day\-to\-day execution. You will manage a meaningful annual budget across campaigns, production, selective media, PR, partnerships, research and specialist support, and work in close, day\-to\-day collaboration with SEO, Product, Operations and Performance Marketing to accelerate Click\&Boat's unpaid growth across multiple geographies.

**What floats your boat**
-------------------------

* Continuously build Click\&Boat's top\-of\-mind awareness and brand preference to establish the company as the undisputed, go\-to destination for boat rentals across target markets, so that brand fame naturally converts into a top\-of\-mind purchasing reflex for any boating occasion.
* Make Click\&Boat synonymous with an easy, flexible and trusted way to rent a boat online, and broaden how customers think about the brand beyond casual day rentals, including family, skippered, multi\-day and higher\-value experiences.
* Set the creative vision for our annual flagship initiatives (e.g., Summer Campaign) and orchestrate high\-impact 360° activations across digital, field/IRL, PR, and brand partnerships to grow brand awareness and consideration.
* Define the creative framework for content and ensure it resonates across our channels, in partnership with Product, SEO, and CRM, who lead execution and leverage reviews, customer stories, and owner expertise to build category trust.
* Ensure content strategy (social media, blog/SEO) stays aligned with the overall brand strategy, in partnership with the respective channel owners.
* Earn relevant attention and third\-party validation, prioritising initiatives that strengthen reputation, direct demand or organic authority.
* Partner with the SEO team on editorial priorities and authority\-building, while SEO retains ownership of the organic channel, technical strategy and performance.
* Experiment with emerging discovery behaviours, including how Click\&Boat is represented and recommended by AI assistants and answer engines, with an approach that is globally coherent and locally effective across priority traveller markets.
* Lead, coach and develop a multidisciplinary team of 7, setting clear priorities and a culture of curiosity, accountability and experimentation, while overseeing external agencies, production partners, creators and technology providers.
* Own Click\&Boat's tone of voice and brand guidelines, helping Product and Operations apply it consistently across renter and owner communications.
* Represent the customer and the brand in senior commercial and product discussions, without losing sight of delivery constraints and return on investment.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


In your first 12 months, you will have:

* Established clear market baselines for trust, mental availability, branded demand and unpaid bookings.
* Aligned content, social, PR and partnerships behind a single strategy and prioritised roadmap.
* Developed and activated a distinctive, trust\-building creative platform across priority markets.
* Launched measurable initiatives that encourage travellers to discover and book before arriving at their destination.
* Created a credible evidence base showing which brand and content investments can be scaled.

**What you bring aboard**
-------------------------

* 8\+ years of experience across consumer brand, content or integrated marketing, ideally in a digital marketplace, travel, e\-commerce or consumer technology business.
* A track record of building or scaling a consumer brand across multiple geographies.
* Experience turning brand strategy into a distinctive creative platform, campaigns and always\-on content \- not simply managing isolated assets.
* Evidence that your work influenced customer acquisition, direct demand, conversion, market share or another meaningful commercial outcome.
* Strong creative judgement combined with analytical discipline and confident budget prioritisation.
* Experience leading a lean, multidisciplinary team and managing agencies or specialist partners.
* Enough understanding of SEO, digital distribution and AI\-assisted discovery to collaborate credibly with specialists, without needing to be a technical SEO practitioner.
* The ability to influence Product and Operations through customer evidence, clear business cases and pragmatic prioritisation.
* Full proficiency in English is required.

**Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Experience working in the US market.
* Fluent in French, Spanish or German.
* Experience in travel, marketplaces, e\-commerce or another low\-frequency, high\-consideration category.
* Experience with brand lift, incrementality testing, marketing\-mix analysis or other approaches to measuring brand investment.
* Experience launching video, creator, community or AI\-discovery programmes.

**How we work**
---------------


This role reports directly to the General Manager so that Brand has the access and organisational weight to influence Click\&Boat's growth agenda. That influence is earned through evidence, prioritisation and delivery. Product owns its roadmap, SEO owns the organic channel, and Operations owns the customer and owner processes; you will help these teams express one coherent, trusted Click\&Boat brand.

**️ The hiring journey**
------------------------

* HR conversation with our Head of Talent Acquisition
* Manager interview with Christian Berces, General Manager
* Collaboration interview 1 with our CPTO
* Collaboration interview 2 with a Brand Manager
* Final validation with senior People and Business leadership


We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

**What awaits you aboard**
--------------------------

* Real strategic scope: shape how Click\&Boat grows its brand and unpaid demand across international markets.
* 23 days of paid leave.
* 10 extra days off (CAB days).
* Restaurant tickets: €3\.50 per worked day, 100% paid by CAB.
* Flexible retribution.
* Wellhub (sport \& wellbeing discounts).
* Hybrid working arrangement: office Monday to Thursday, remote on Fridays.
* Boat licence: \-40% via partnerships.
* Boat hire vouchers for friends \& family, no commission when you're on board, 50% commission for your immediate family.
* Free bike parking, and discounted car parking.


Contract: Full\-time, permanent.


Team: 7 direct/indirect reports (4 permanent, 3 interns/apprentices).

**Ready to come aboard?**
-------------------------


If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit "apply to this job"


At Click\&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We hire for talent.

Creative Strategist
description:
**About the Role**
------------------


As our Creative Strategist, you will own creative performance from audience insight through concept development, testing, and optimization, turning consumer behavior and performance data into creative strategies that drive measurable growth.


This is a highly hands\-on, analytical role for someone who combines strong creative instincts with a deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, customer psychology, and paid social performance. You’ll research audiences, develop new concepts and angles, analyze creative performance, and continuously identify opportunities to improve what we test and how we scale winning ideas.


At Acentecom, we believe the strongest creative strategies start with a deep understanding of the customer and evolve through continuous experimentation. We’re looking for someone who can connect audience insights, creative thinking, and performance data to make better decisions and drive stronger results.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* Develop a deep understanding of audiences, customer psychology, and market behavior, identifying pain points, desires, objections, beliefs, and emotional drivers and translating them into actionable creative opportunities.
* Build and continuously evolve a pipeline of creative concepts, hooks, angles, personas, messaging frameworks, and formats, ensuring ideas are grounded in audience insights and clear strategic hypotheses.
* Own creative performance analysis across paid social, using metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS to identify patterns, diagnose performance, and determine what to test next.
* Build structured creative testing and experimentation frameworks, isolating variables across hooks, visuals, scripts, messaging, and personas to understand what drives performance.
* Identify and scale winning creative patterns, systematically iterating on successful concepts while continuously introducing new hypotheses and testing opportunities.
* Partner closely with Media Buying, CRO, Copywriting, Video Editing, and Creative teams to connect creative performance with the broader funnel and translate cross\-functional insights into stronger advertising strategies.
* Guide and support Video Editors, providing clear strategic direction and performance\-based feedback around hooks, pacing, retention, engagement, and overall creative effectiveness.
* Turn research, testing results, and performance data into clear recommendations and next actions, maintaining visibility into key learnings, market trends, competitor activity, and opportunities for growth.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, customer psychology, consumer behavior, and paid social creative strategy.
* Strong hands\-on experience in e\-commerce, ideally DTC e\-commerce, within a high\-volume, performance\-driven environment.
* Strong experience in Creative Strategy, Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, or a related performance\-driven creative role.
* Hands\-on experience analyzing Meta and paid social creative performance, with the ability to understand why creatives perform and translate that analysis into better concepts and testing decisions.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working with creative performance metrics, including hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS.
* Experience developing creative concepts, hooks, angles, messaging, personas, and testing hypotheses based on audience research and performance insights.
* Strong understanding of creative testing and experimentation, with experience building structured tests, interpreting results, and scaling winning concepts.
* Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Triple Whale, or similar performance analytics platforms.
* Experience collaborating closely with Media Buyers, CRO teams, Copywriters, Video Editors, and creative production teams.
* A highly proactive and autonomous approach. You’re naturally curious, comfortable challenging assumptions, and able to move from research to hypothesis to execution without requiring detailed direction.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, provide clear creative direction and feedback, and turn performance insights into actionable recommendations.

title: Creative Lead (Social & UGC)
description:
**Who we are**
==============


Creative Milkshake is a remote\-first performance creative agency. We make scroll\-stopping short\-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok \- high\-volume, fast\-moving, and built to convert.


We’re a close\-knit team of \~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing \- in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.


Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC\-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.

**The role**
============


We make a lot of content. Across a portfolio of DTC clients, our studio shoots and edits dozens of UGC ads every week. Most of it is good. Some of it is great. And the difference between good and great is specific: the hook that actually stops the scroll, the edit that holds attention, the subtle thing that makes a piece of content feel native rather than forced. That's what this role is about.


We’re looking for a Creative Lead (Social \& UGC) to be the final creative eye before work reaches clients. You'll review raw footage, storyboards, and final edits, and give the kind of specific, hands\-on feedback that actually improves the work rather than just flags problems.


You’ve made content yourself. You’ve been on set, you’ve been in the edit, you know what it takes to make a 15\-second video that does something to the person watching it. You bring that maker's instinct to a quality and creative leadership role, and you use it to raise the bar across a whole studio.

**Timezone preference**
=======================


For this role, we're only considering candidates based in \+/ 3 hrs CET time zone.

  

**What you’ll do**
==================

**Hold the creative quality bar**
---------------------------------

* Review storyboards, raw footage when necessary, and final edits before they go to clients
* Be the quality gate: if something isn’t ready, you say so clearly, and you explain exactly what needs to change and why
* Build and maintain the ad example library, creative checklists, and “what good looks like” guides that codify your instinct into something the whole team can learn from
* Spot recurring patterns: editing habits that aren't working, storyboard mistakes that keep appearing, hooks that aren't landing. Address them at the root, not ad by ad

**Give hands\-on creative direction in post**
---------------------------------------------

* Review raw footage after shoots and provide clear direction on what’s usable, what’s not, and what to do differently next time
* Give precise editing feedback to our video editors: pacing, cut points, text overlays, sound design, the craft layer that turns a decent edit into something that performs
* Understand design fundamentals well enough to give direction on static assets, thumbnail frames, and text treatments: what reads on a phone screen and what doesn't
* Know what a 9:16 UGC ad needs to do in the first 2 seconds, and be able to articulate it in a way an editor can act on immediately

**Support production with a creative eye**
------------------------------------------

* Review storyboards before shoots and flag what isn’t shootable as written, what talent or set requirements are missing, and where the brief and the concept have drifted
* Give production the creative context they need to go into a shoot prepared: what angles matter, what the edit is going to need, what “good” looks like for this format and this brand
* Periodically join shoots at the Amsterdam studio (\+\-3 times a year) when creative stakes are high or a new format is being tested
* Over time, help build a visual reference library for the studio: what set styles, lighting setups, and shooting approaches produce the most versatile footage

**Drive platform and content intelligence**
-------------------------------------------

* Maintain a genuine, current relationship with TikTok, Meta, and emerging short\-form platforms: scrolling with a critical eye, not just awareness
* Curate a regular inspiration feed for the team: specific content examples with notes on why they work, what the craft decisions are, and how we could produce something similar in our studio
* Know the difference between a format worth adopting and a trend worth skipping, and be able to make the case either way
* Bring fresh creative references when the team’s output starts feeling formulaic or dated

**Build the team’s creative instinct**
--------------------------------------

* Give Creative Strategists feedback on CSPs and scripts that builds their creative eye over time, not just fixes the brief in front of them
* Run regular creative review sessions and inspiration shares that create a shared language for what “good” means at Creative Milkshake
* Be the person the team brings work to when they're not sure if it's there yet, and give them an answer they can trust

**Own CM’s creative identity externally**
-----------------------------------------

* Approve CM's own social content and website portfolio: what we put out about ourselves should reflect the standard we hold for clients
* Help define and document CM’s creative POV over time: the format instincts, the aesthetic signatures, the things that make our content recognizably ours

  

**Who you are**
===============


We’re not filtering on titles. We're looking for a specific type of person: someone with a sharp creative eye for what works on social, who wants to use that experience to raise the quality of an entire studio's output.

* 3–7 years of hands\-on experience in video production, editing, content creation, or a creative role at a social\-first agency or DTC brand. You've made things, not just briefed them
* A genuine, current feel for short\-form social content: you scroll TikTok and Meta with a critical eye, you notice what’s working before it’s obvious, and you can describe the craft decisions behind it in specific terms
* Ability to understand paid media and performance marketing reports to inform creative decisions
* Real editing experience, or close enough collaboration with editors, that you speak the language of the edit
* Enough on\-set or production experience to spot when a storyboard isn’t going to translate, and know what to do about it
* The ability to tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain why in a way the person who made it can actually use
* Feedback that is specific, timestamped, and producible, not vague creative notes that leave people guessing
* High EQ: you can give honest creative feedback without damaging the confidence or the relationship of the person on the other end
* Comfortable with ambiguity and pace: we're building systems while operating at volume
* Fluent in English, confident presenting creative rationale to clients when needed

  

**Backgrounds that tend to produce this person**
================================================


There’s no single path. People who are great at this role often come from one of these places:

* A video editor or post\-production lead who has developed a strong creative eye for social, and wants to work upstream on quality rather than just executing edits
* A UGC creator or content creator who has built a real, granular understanding of what performs and why, and wants to bring that instinct to a studio environment at scale
* A creative producer who sits between strategy and production, has strong taste, and wants to formalise that into a quality leadership role
* A social content lead or in\-house creative at a DTC brand who has been hands\-on with short\-form video and wants to take their creative judgement further

**What they all share: they’ve made things, they have taste, and they can teach it.**

  

**You’ll thrive here if…**
==========================

* You get genuinely excited about the craft of short\-form video: the hook, the cut, the text timing, the sound. You find it hard to watch a mediocre ad without knowing what you'd fix
* You want a role where your creative instinct directly improves what goes out the door every week
* You’re energised by the challenge of holding a high standard at volume: lots of content, lots of clients, fast turnarounds
* You want to shape creative culture from the inside: setting a standard, building the resources that make a team better, defining what “good” means at a growing studio
* The idea of helping a UGC studio move toward elevated social\-first content over the next couple of years sounds like exactly the right moment to join

**This role isn’t for you if…**
===============================

* You’ve only worked in creative strategy or performance marketing and haven’t been hands\-on with video production or editing
* Your creative background is in brand identity or traditional advertising rather than short\-form, social\-first content
* You prefer to stay in the strategic or conceptual space and find production and editing detail less interesting
* You’re primarily looking for a people\-management role. Your influence here comes through creative expertise, not team size

  

**What we offer**
=================

* Creative Milkshake Stipends (mental health, healthcare \& internet)
* Time Off: 21 days PTO \+ 7 Paid Sick Days; company closure: 2 weeks at year\-end (estimated: December 22 – January 5\)
* Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Yearly Salary Review
* Long Service Incentives (starting from 2 years)

title: Performance Creative Strategist
description:
ABOUT US
  
  

Reach Digital is an AI\-first performance marketing agency helping eCommerce and digital product brands scale through creative, paid media, and landing pages. We are a true growth partner \- going deep with brands to become integrated into their marketing team. We drive real growth by combining data, testing, and new ideas.
  
  

We're a fully remote team of creatives, editors, and growth strategists. We care about the work, and care about being the best at what we do.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
  

As a Creative Strategist at Reach, you own the creative end\-to\-end. You'll do the research, develop ad angles, write hooks, and build creative briefs that our editors execute, working directly with our brand partners and growth/design teams.
  
  

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
  
  

You have 2\+ years of digital marketing experience
  
  

You understand paid media and the types of content that converts
  
  

You enjoy brainstorming ad angles and concepts, then bringing them to life
  
  

You are detail\-orientated, organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  
  

You're willing to learn and get better even when that means giving and receiving feedback
  
  

You are comfortable communicating learnings with both team members and clients
  
  

You're genuinely passionate about creative strategy and staying on top of what's working \- you do this because you want to, not because you have to
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  
  

Analyzing performance, brainstorming ad angles and hook variations, and writing new briefs weekly for the editing team to produce
  
  

Owning the creative strategy for your brand partners, including a living strategy doc that tracks angles, performance, and what to test next
  
  

Staying current on platform trends, winning ad formats, and policy changes, and translating that into testable concepts for your accounts
  
  

Working with 3\-5 brand partners at a time, with a focus on going deep into their creative and building new winning ads
  
  

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM US
  
  

**Growth:** We invest in the people who invest in the work. Expect regular creative reviews, direct feedback, and room to grow into senior roles as Reach scales.
  
  

**Weekly Calls \& Creative Training:** Weekly team check\-ins, creative reviews and training sessions. Calls are typically held between 12pm–6pm EST on weekdays.
  
  

Generous PTO and benefits policy
  
  

Fully remote role (working US hours)
  
  

Competitive compensation in USD
  
  

The Hiring Process
  
  

All candidates will go through a 15\-minute questionnaire. Following this, top candidates will be given a culture fit interview before being given a paid, take\-home assignment.

description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\-us/

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a highly systematic **Senior Creative Producer** to own the ad creative engine for one of our core D2C subscription products in the consumer AI category. You will be fully responsible for the full concept\-to\-performance loop, generating the angles, driving production volume, running structured tests, performing competitor research, and turning creative\-level data into the next round of winning concepts.


This is a high\-impact role. Your ad creatives will be the primary performance lever: your work moves CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS directly, and you are accountable for those numbers alongside the User Acquisition team. The bar is high and so is the upside; performance here is directly and significantly rewarded.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Creative Strategy \& Concepting**


	+ Own the creative angle strategy: Define which hooks, pains, and value propositions get tested next
	+ Develop creative concepts: demo\-led ads, UGC\-style video, statics, and AI\-generated formats
	+ Translate product features and capabilities into concrete, scroll\-stopping propositions for target audiences
	+ Build and maintain a documented library of proven angles, hooks, and creative patterns### **Production \& Testing Velocity**


	+ Own the creative pipeline across ad networks (Google, YouTube, Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, Applovin, etc) shipping new concepts every week
	+ Structure systematic A/B testing frameworks, isolate variables, and analyze the results to bring solid conclusions.
	+ Produce clear creative briefs for designers to execute high\-performing concepts aligned with the brand.### **Performance Analysis \& Iteration**


	+ Own creative\-level metrics: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS
	+ Generate testable hypotheses from performance data and retire underperforming angles quickly
	+ Identify winning patterns, codify why they work, and scale them into new concept batches
	+ Deliver structured creative performance reviews with clear recommendations for the next cycle### **Market Research \& Collaboration**


	+ Run systematic competitor creative research across ad libraries and creative intelligence tools
	+ Track emerging formats, platform policy shifts, and creative trends in the consumer AI category
	+ Communicate daily with User Acquisition Managers, taking briefs on which angles need more volume

**Qualifications**
==================

**Must\-Have Experience**

* **4\+ years** producing performance ad creative for D2C or subscription consumer products
* Proven track record of **high\-volume output**, shipping and live\-testing multiple new concepts weekly
* Deep working knowledge of the major ad network ecosystems (**Google, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat**, etc).
* **Demonstrated fluency with an AI production** stack across image, video, voice, and scripting tools
* Ability to read creative\-level performance data independently and act on it without an analyst in the loop
* Experience building structured creative testing frameworks, not ad\-hoc one\-off tests
* **Strong portfolio** of ads with verifiable performance results. (Applications must include a CV and a portfolio of ad creative you personally produced).

**Leadership Attributes**

* Systematic operator. You build repeatable creative processes, not one\-time wins
* Fully accountable for performance outcomes, not just delivery of assets
* Fast and decisive under volume. Comfortable killing your own concepts when data says so
* Treats User Acquisition as a working partner, not a downstream recipient of files

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============


Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company\-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top\-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab\=t.0\#heading\=h.ndsdl4wapxtt


Be part of our fast\-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Take\-Home Assignment
* First Interview (60 minutes)
* Final Interview (40 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.


This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.


Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

title: UGC Creative Director (Contractor)
description:
Thousands of creators across our partner agencies post about Picsart's AI tools every week, and we're scaling that many times over. In this role, you decide what they make: the concepts, hooks, angles, scripts and briefs. You build rough examples in Picsart's own tools so creators and editors can see the idea instead of reading about it, and you run the tests that show which creative turns a viewer into someone who generates, spends credits and pays. You'll be working across all our social platforms: TikTok, Meta, Instagram, Youtube, X, and Reddit.

  



You work through AI, because nobody can watch that much content by hand. You'll use it to read everything the network publishes, to draft briefs and variations for every agency and creator, and to spot winners early, then you make the call and make the example. The best agencies now publish their playbooks; your edge is running that discipline across every agency at once, with the one dataset no agency has: what happens after the click.

  



How success looks like for this role within a year: conversion per view rising while volume rises, and winning creative replicating across markets in days.

  



Please note that this is a **Full\-Time Contractor (12\-month contract) role.**



**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------


* **Decide what creators make.** The concepts, hooks and scripts they film each week. Agencies bring local ideas; you pick what the whole network runs.
* **Write briefs creators can follow.** Not documents they skim, clear direction, plus rough cuts and examples you make in Picsart's own tools, so nobody has to guess what you meant.
* **Test the creative.** Hook against hook, format against format, market against market. The results decide what runs next, not anyone's taste.
* **Get content finished.** Work directly with creators and editors to turn concepts into posts, and give feedback specific enough to act on.
* **Find out what converts.** Look at what thousands of videos actually did, and point the network at the audiences and use cases that bring in paying users.
* **Spread what wins.** When a hook works in one market, get it into every other market and language fast, and into templates users can remix themselves.
* **Own launch content.** Every new model and feature goes out through the creator network within days. You decide what day one looks like.
* **Tell product what to build.** You see what people want from AI tools before product does. Turn that into concrete asks: which presets, templates and models to build or promote next.
* **Keep it fresh and safe.** Stop the whole network from copying last month's winner. And when a platform changes its rules or a theme crosses a trust\-and\-safety line, the network hears it from you first.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------


* **A portfolio, not a résumé:** **social accounts you've grown.** Your own or a client's. Send the links and tell us what the numbers did while you ran them.
* **Creator networks you've directed.** How many creators, what you taught them, what came out of it.
* **Content you made yourself.** Rough cuts, scripts, hooks, examples, not just feedback on other people's work.
* **Comment\-to\-DM and link funnels.** You've set them up, watched them break, and fixed them.
* **Short\-form content that worked in more than one market or language.** You know which hooks travelled and which ones didn't.
* **Real use of AI creation tools.** You've made things with them, not just read about them.
* **Creative testing.** You've run hook against hook, format against format, and let the results decide.
* **Clear writing.** A brief a creator can follow, and a short update an executive can read.
* **Great communication skills in English.** Any other languages are a plus.

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 London, GB
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House \& Garden and Tatler, among many others.
   

  

 We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
   

  

 Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday \- Thursday).
   

  

 We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
   

  

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.
   

  

 You excel at guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, fast\-paced workflows, bringing executive\-level problem\-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
   

  

 Individual \& Team Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop bold multi\-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi\-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands\-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward\-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.


**Essential Skills \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer\-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on\-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre\- to post\-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production \- writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.


**Desired Qualities**
* Culturally informed \- Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative \- You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail\-oriented \- Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable \- Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically \- You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego\-less attitude \- You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor \- You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.


 What benefits do we offer?
   

  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.
* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours, 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme, corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog\-friendly office, plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions, keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.
* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.


**What happens next?**
 If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

title: Creative Director
description:
**Creative Director** 




 Live visuals across brand, music and culture
 



  





 Location: Central London studio, 5\-day week, 2\-3 days WFH
 



 Salary: £75,000
 



 Type: Permanent, Full\-time
 



  





**About rapt** 





 rapt is a multimedia studio making immersive and interactive experiences. A Projection show on a landmark building, LED at stage scale, real\-time visuals. One month a campaign launch in London, the next live visuals for an arena tour, the next an installation in a disused power station or the Nevada desert.
 




  






 We work with global brands, artists and cultural institutions. Previous names include BOSS, Nike, Valentino, McLaren, New Balance, TAG Heuer, Audemars Piguet, Netflix and Diageo. And the work doesn't stop with brands. We have an artistic practice of our own, and the self\-initiated work feeds back into everything else. The last thing we want an audience to feel is nothing.
 




  






 We're a small team working on big projects all over the world, and the studio is growing. This role plays a real part in shaping what it becomes next.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Creative Director to lead creative across pitches and live projects. Sharp conceptual thinking, a strong visual sensibility, and the ability to take an idea from first response through to what the audience actually experiences. Projects range from arena tours and festival main stages to building\-scale projection and gallery installations.
 



  





 This is a creative director with a producer's hat on. You need to know what it takes to make the idea real. Which people, how many days, what budget, what pipeline, and whether it lands on time. Not just the creative, but how realistic the creative is to deliver. You'll lead teams made up of internal people and external specialists, built per project from our freelance roster. You brief them, run them and sign off their work.
 



  





 You'll be running several pitches and several projects at the same time. Being highly organised isn't a nice\-to\-have here.
 



  





 You'll need to be fluent in immersive formats and creative technology, confident communicating ideas to clients and internal teams, and hands\-on enough to sketch, write or visualise ideas yourself when needed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





*Pitches* 



* Lead creative direction on pitch responses. Approach every brief strategically: what the objective is, who the audience is, and what the angle is that wins it.
* Translate briefs into clear creative strategy and strong, original ideas.
* Shape visual concepts, narratives and deck content.
* Scope the content side: team, days and cost, working with the project manager. If the idea can't be built for the number, say so early.



  





*Projects* 



* Own creative quality from concept through production to delivery on site.
* Build, brief and manage freelance content teams from our roster: 2D, 3D, real\-time, interactive, sound.
* Plan the content production: schedule it, resource it, track it, keep it on budget with the help of our internal team.
* Review and sign off content before it goes to the client or hits the media server.
* Present work to clients and collaborators with clarity and confidence.



  





*Studio* 



* Uphold creative standards across everything that leaves the studio.
* Motivate and guide creative teams across disciplines, from concept to delivery.
* Feed into internal R\&D and help shape the future creative direction of rapt.



  





**Key Skills \& Experience** 



* Proven experience making work for big spaces and big crowds, arena screens, building facades, one\-off sites, not just standard agency\-format content.
* A hands\-on tools background. You've come up through making, whether design, 3D, motion or real\-time, and grown into creative direction. You know roughly how a thing gets built and can navigate a project through it. Time spent agency side and a track record of winning pitches are both a plus.
* Strong creative strategy skills and an ability to frame ideas clearly for clients.
* Producer's instincts. You've scoped and costed content production before and know what a team of artists actually takes, in people, days and money.
* A clear eye for design, narrative and spatial storytelling.
* You can illustrate your own ideas. Sketch, storyboard, style frame, mock up. When you show an idea, people see it.
* Working knowledge of 2D, 3D, real\-time (Unreal, Notch, TouchDesigner) and Gen AI workflows.
* Experience working across immersive, spatial, digital or experiential formats.
* Experience building and managing freelance teams.
* Comfort collaborating with technical and production teams across disciplines.
* Highly organised. Able to lead multiple pitches and projects at once through ambiguity and deadlines without the quality slipping.
* Strong communication skills and confidence presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Live work sometimes means evenings and weekends on site.



  





**Perks** 



* 22 days holiday (plus public holidays), increasing with tenure
* Birthday off
* Private healthcare (including dentist and optician)
* Hybrid working (2\-3 days WFH per week)



  





**How to apply** 




 Please email your:
 


* CV
* Portfolio



 Email to: opportunities@rapt.co
 



 Deadline for Application: 4th October

 connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are
   

  

 invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

 selling videogame franchises, award\-winning interactive technology, fan programs,

 that ignite the emotion of sport through industry\-leading sports video games,
   

  

 including Madden NFL and College Football , FC soccer, NHL hockey, and
   

  

 EA SPORTS UFC .
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision\-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user\-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high\-fidelity consumer experiences.
   

  

 Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design\-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 Experience Strategy:
   

  

* Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long\-term, multi\-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.
* Consumer\-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high\-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long\-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.


**Connected Fan Experiences**
* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end\-to\-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.
* Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.
* Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network\-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user\-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.
* Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.
* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.


**Experience Innovation \& Data Informed Design**
* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next\-generation interaction models, including AI\-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real\-time sports feed integrations.
* Data\-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.


**Your Qualifications**
* Experience: 10\+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world\-class, large\-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi\-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high\-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling \& Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.


**About Electronic Arts**

description:

We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health \& wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.


Hims \& Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how\-it\-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent\-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers\-professionals.

**About the Role:**
-------------------


We're standing up a new in house video arm for paid social at Hims \& Hers, bringing high volume ad production in house so we can move faster and work across every category and both brands, Hims and Hers. The Creative Lead is a foundational hire in that build, not a role slotting into an existing team. **It's a hands on role based in Los Angeles**, with in person attendance on set on a varied schedule that follows the shoots, not a typical office week.


As Creative Lead, you're the creative engine of the pod, partnering with a marketing Creative Strategist who sets the initial vision, direction, and scripts for each concept. From there, it's on you to bring that vision to life visually, directing the shoot, shaping the look, and pulling in your Producer and editorial counterparts to get each concept shot, cut, and shipped at volume.


This is a hands on, wear many hats role. You're not waiting around for a finished brief, you're a genuine creative partner from the earliest idea, and you're comfortable adapting fast as priorities, categories, and brands shift.


You'll work across both Hims and Hers and each category, taking direction from Strategists on either line of business and executing it with your own creative craft. Producing at the volume this pod needs means staying hands on across the whole path from concept to a launched, high performing ad, not just owning one piece of it.

**You Will:**
-------------

* Partner with the marketing Creative Strategist from the earliest concept stage, translating their vision and scripts into a fully realized visual approach.
* Own the visual execution of the pod's output end to end, bringing the Strategist's scripts and concepts to life on screen, and contributing to copy or hooks when it helps.
* Be ready to direct shoots in person, giving real time notes to talent, crew, and production, and step behind the camera yourself (when needed) for lean, quick turnaround setups.
* Adjust lines on set when needed to keep the words and the visuals in sync. The scripts themselves come from the Strategist, but your read on what's working in the room matters.
* Shoot roughly 5 to 10 variants per concept to feed the post production iteration pipeline.
* Partner closely with the Producer on shoot planning, covering locations, talent, props, wardrobe, and shot lists.
* Collaborate with editorial and post production on every cut, giving clear, specific feedback to keep the work aligned with the original creative vision.
* Maintain a high bar for craft across the board, composition, typography, color, motion, clarity, and voice, even at high volume and speed.
* Translate what's winning in performance back into visual direction for future concepts and shoots, sharing insights with the Strategist to help shape future scripts.

**You Have:**
-------------

* 6 to 9 years of experience in art direction, video direction, or design, with copywriting or scripting as a secondary skill, and a portfolio spanning concept development and video first paid social or branded content, not just execution of others' briefs.
* Demonstrated experience developing visual treatments, along with giving clear creative direction to crews, talent, and editors.
* Hands on shooting experience, comfortable operating a camera yourself for lean shoots, not only directing a crew.
* Comfortable contributing to copy, hooks, or scripts when it's useful, even though scripts are typically owned by the Creative Strategist.
* Proven ability to concept and ship video first ads quickly in fast paced, high volume environments, balancing craft and business needs to deliver effective solutions with minimal guidance.
* Deep understanding of platform best practices for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap, and emerging short form formats.
* Comfort collaborating across functions with editorial, production, and other internal creative teams, including distributed or offshore teams, to protect creative vision through iteration.
* Comfort adapting your craft and creative point of view across multiple brands, categories, and audiences within a shared production system, rather than staying limited to a single brand.
* Strong creative instincts across both visual storytelling and voice, with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and other relevant AI creative tools.
* Comfort working with performance data as a guide for creative decisions, not just craft instinct, exercising sound judgment in balancing creative risk against practical constraints driven by the business.
* A true go getter, comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting fast as the needs of the business change, in a lean, fast moving in house team rather than an agency structure.

**Portfolio Requirements**


Please include a link to your portfolio or reel showing your role in concept development, storyboarding, visual direction, and scripting or copywriting where relevant, not just finished footage. Be clear about your specific contribution, whether concept, storyboard, director, DP, writer, or editor, on each project.

* Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental \& vision, and parental leave

 Engine is the all\-in\-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K\+ businesses and groups representing 1\.8M\+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest\-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. We built it, AI\-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
   

  

 Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
 **build as much as they lead** 
 shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.

 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.

 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.

 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.

 Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.

 Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.

* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance\-driven digital work.
* Hands\-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.

* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.

**Overview**
 The Creative Director is a proven creative leader who consistently develops disruptive, culture\-shaping ideas that cut through and drive earned\-worthy moments for clients. Leading an integrated Art and Copy team, you bring both conceptual rigor and the self\-editing skills to shape campaigns with minimal oversight. You thrive as a hands\-on creative, formulating bold ideas on brief, directing executions, and presenting directly to clients with confidence and clarity. **Responsibilities**
**Creative Leadership \& Idea Development**
* Lead and own creative work across assigned accounts, consistently and independently generating a high volume of original, disruptive ideas grounded in strategy and on brief
* Develop compelling creative concepts that align with HUNTER client objectives and measurable KPIs; demonstrate strong self\-editing skills to shape ideas into award\-worthy, culture\-disrupting campaigns

* Lead creative concepting, brainstorms, and strategy sessions with energy and conviction, fostering bold thinking and pushing boundaries within strategic intent
* Concept and direct across disciplines; developing storyboards, comps, copy, and integrated executions that showcase creative excellence
* Deliver compelling pitch presentations and new business concepts; serve as a confident external\-facing creative voice for HUNTER when needed
* Review all work with ECD and Sr. Integrated Creative Director to ensure alignment and creative excellence before presenting to internal account and client teams

**Creative Direction \& Execution**
* Establish strong visual \& copy direction and creative standards for assigned work, guiding Art Directors, Copywriters, Designers and Producers toward executions that match creative intent

* Demonstrate strong conceptual writing skills paired with strategic thinking; ability to articulate ideas with precision and clarity
* Provide precise, actionable feedback that elevates creative work across ideation, design, and visual execution
* Ensure executions are delivered on time and on budget, with quality matching or exceeding creative vision
* Work seamlessly with Creative Production Leads to handle all production and post\-production across design, video, and experiences

**Team Leadership \& Mentorship**

* Mentor Copywriters, Art Directors and Designers at various levels, elevating their thinking, strengthening their craft, and growing the next generation of creative leaders

* Foster a collaborative team culture where bold ideas are encouraged, feedback is constructive and respectful, and exceptional work is celebrated
* Conduct project\-based performance feedback and contribute to formal performance review processes; support career development and growth
* Demonstrate maturity in navigating challenging client situations, finding creative opportunities even within difficult constraints
* Collaborate with flexibility and confidence to build account team and client trust and ensure satisfaction while maintaining HUNTER's creative standards
