title: Product Manager, Amazon Alexa
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


At Amazon Devices \& Services, we imagine the future, and then create it. Join brilliant minds to build new categories of technology that become part of everyone's everyday life. Together, we create connected experiences that transform lives, communities, and the world with our work.  

  

The Amazon Alexa International team is looking for a Product Manager to own and shape the Alexa experience for customers in Spain. In this role, you will contribute to the product vision and roadmap for Alexa in the Spanish marketplace — identifying customer opportunities, setting priorities, and driving execution across a complex, cross\-functional landscape. You will work backwards from Spanish customers to determine what a truly delightful, locally relevant personal assistant experience looks like, and then make it happen.  

  

In this role, you will define ambiguous problems, shape goals from customer insight and data, and design solutions that scale. You will make high\-judgment calls with incomplete information, navigate technical trade\-offs alongside engineering partners, and balance near\-term delivery against long\-term architectural integrity. You will take calculated risks in pursuit of ambitious outcomes — and own the results.  

  

If you are passionate about AI, love building products that delight millions of customers, and want to shape the future of Alexa in Spain, we look forward to your application.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Support the product development of Alexa in Spain: define the what and why, not just the how, working backwards from Spanish customer needs and market dynamics
* Work in the product roadmap end\-to\-end: identify opportunities, prioritize effectively, and deliver measurable customer experience improvements
* Navigate ambiguity; problems and approach may not be defined. Use expertise, customer insight, and data to determine the right goals and design long\-term solutions
* Be the Voice of the Customer: conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and market analysis to distinguish representative signal from anecdotal feedback across the Spanish customer base
* Drive data\-informed decisions: define success metrics, analyze data and customer behaviour, and identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for improvement
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with engineering, science, design, localization, marketing, legal, and operations teams: influence without authority to build alignment across teams with different priorities
* Own launches and post\-launch performance: drive awareness, adoption, and continuous optimization of the Alexa experience
* Contribute to organizational planning: participate in strategic planning, write narratives and drive product discussions with Senior Managers and Directors
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs: understand how technology choices influence customer outcomes, ask the right questions, and balance feature delivery with sustainability

  

* Please note, Amazon is an English\-speaking company day\-to\-day

  

About the team  

This role is part of the Alexa International organization, which develops and supports the Alexa experience across all international markets. You will operate within the European team, working closely with country teams across Europe while contributing to the Spanish marketplace roadmap. The team is passionate about building locally relevant, delightful experiences powered by AI technology.  

  

Location for this role is in Madrid.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience with product localization and building locally relevant customer experiences
* Experience applying GenAI tools (e.g., coding assistants, AI agents) to accelerate delivery and/or improve quality
* Native\-level (C2\) fluency in written and verbal Spanish including cultural fluency, including regional humour, tone, idiom, and social context

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with voice/AI products, conversational interfaces, or natural language technologies
* Speak, write, and read fluently in other EU languages
* Experience in process automation, and tool development using AI

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. The Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware owns Pearson’s global portfolio of English language learning materials for schools, higher education and adult education. The portfolio spans print, blended and digital courseware, supplementary materials, teacher professional development, and partner\-created content.


This is an opportunity to shape the future of a major global education portfolio. The role leads a global team of approximately 15 colleagues through managers and works across Content, Learning Science, Engineering, Assessment, UX and AI. You own the relationships and the execution: finding and signing agencies and creators, the agreements, getting content published, tracking what it drives, and deciding which partnerships to keep, grow or end.

  



You'll run a network the size of a department with a team of two. AI does what a team of ten used to: it builds the outreach lists, screens agencies and creators, scores every partner's performance and drafts the reporting. Data, Finance and Legal do their parts. You decide what the machine does and make the calls it can't. This is a role for someone who already works this way.

  



Please note that this is a **Full\-time Contractor (12 months)** role.


**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------


* **Find and sign partners.** Agencies and creators in every market that matters, working toward 50 agencies and 500,000 creators. You know where the good ones are and how to reach them.
* **Get the agreements done.** Terms, exclusivity, data access, rights and payment: in writing, on Picsart's terms, with Finance and Legal behind you.
* **Get campaigns published.** Live on time, in every market, at the volume agreed. Every post carries its link, its code and its creator, so nothing goes out untracked.
* **Track what each partner drives.** Signups, first generations, credits used, paying users and big spenders, in dashboards the Data team builds to your spec.
* **Decide who continues.** Recommend which partnerships to grow, hold or end based on what they convert, not what they view. Scale what repeats; cut what was lucky.
* **Grow revenue and usage.** 100x the revenue and AI credit use coming from the influencer and affiliate programs. Pay for results, never for views, and put the money behind what converts.
* **Build Picsart's own creator base.** Creators that agencies bring in end up on Picsart's terms, in Picsart's database, with a direct relationship, so agencies stay a choice, not a dependency.
* **Sell the network to partners.** AI model partners and brands already pay to run campaigns with our creators. Bring in more of that money so it covers a growing share of what the network costs.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Partnerships you've run at scale.** Creator, affiliate, UGC or influencer.
* **A network you grew from a handful to dozens.** You signed the partners that worked and ended the ones that didn't.
* **A head for numbers.** You can work out what a partner costs you per paying user, and whether they earn back what you pay them.

* 6\+ years of professional experience in privacy, data or technology policy, regulatory affairs, or a closely related field
* Fluency in English and French, as the role requires direct engagement with French\-speaking regulators and policymakers in the EU
* Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant fields
* Demonstrated expertise in AI policy and in the privacy and data protection framework of the EU digital landscape (GDPR, AI Act, DSA/DMA, Data Act)

* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional programmes, including business process management, workflow and lifecycle management
* Strong presentation, writing, and stakeholder\-management skills, including those with senior external audiences

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimise/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

title: Head of Operations — Switching, Billing & Cash Collection / energy retail experience
description:
Company Description
  
MET Retail is a new chapter for the group: bringing energy directly to households. We're building a technology\-driven retail platform for power and gas, with a digital, customer\-first model. One model, built to scale across Europe.


We're a small international team, and there's a lot to build. Join us on this exciting journey and you'll help shape how this company works, with real ownership from day one.


  
Job Description
  
We are building a digital retail platform for residential customers. The Head of Operations brings practical operational knowledge into digital delivery: understanding market, regulatory, commercial and process needs, designing the way we work, and making sure the operational engine behind the customer journey is accurate, compliant, scalable and AI\-enabled by design rather than by retrofit.


The role covers the transactional backbone of the end\-to\-end customer journey (from contracting to switching, first bill, invoicing and collection) across our billing, CRM and operational tooling. Spain at launch, followed by other markets such as France, Germany and Italy. The person in this role will own switching, billing and invoicing, and cash collection end to end, from process and procedure design through business ownership of the supporting tooling, team build\-up and day\-to\-day performance.


This is a build role, and an AI\-first one. The processes, the controls, the procedures and the team do not exist yet; you will create them. We expect the operating model to be designed around automation and AI from the first process map, with the manual path treated as the exception rather than the starting point.


**Key responsibilities**

* Act as the business reference point for switching, billing, invoicing and cash collection across the Spanish operation and, subsequently, the markets that follow.
* Design and own the end\-to\-end switching process (cambio de comercializadora), including ATR request management, SIPS data validation, contract activation and exception handling
* Define the operational interface with the distribution system operators (e\-distribución, i\-DE, UFD, e\-redes, Viesgo and regional DSOs)
* Manage the operational side of customer exits and win\-back, including debt\-related switching constraints
* Design the billing cycle end to end: meter data acquisition and validation, estimation logic, tariff application across residential structures (2\.0TD for electricity, RL and TUR bands for gas), rebilling and corrections. Cash Collection \& Credit Risk
* Design and run the collections’ function: SEPA Core direct debit cycles (Cuaderno 19 / 19\-14\), bank reconciliation (Cuaderno 43\), returns and unpaid handling, and alternative payment methods
* Write the operating model: process maps, standard operating procedures, RACI, control framework and an escalation model that holds up under regulatory and financial audit
* Hire, structure and lead the operations team
* Identify, prioritise and specify AI use cases across the meter\-to\-cash chain
* Set the target automation ratio per process and raise it every quarter
* Collaborate across Offering, Growth, Customer Service and Finance on the business side, and Product, Architecture, Engineering and Data on the delivery side.

  
Qualifications
  
* University degree
* At least 5 years of **experience in energy retail operations** , with direct, hands\-on ownership of switching, billing or cash collection in the Spanish market
* Solid command of the Spanish regulatory framework for residential electricity and/or gas retail: ATR processes, tariff structure, regulated charges, supply\-interruption rules and consumer protection obligations
* Proven experience setting up processes, procedures and teams from scratch
* Strong practical understanding of the meter\-to\-cash chain and of the operational, commercial and regulatory constraints that shape it in a B2C environment
* Demonstrable, practical understanding of AI and automation applied to operational problems
* Comfortable with SQL, data models, APIs and file\-based integrations
* Experience acting as business owner for a core operational platform — defining requirements, supporting vendor evaluation, driving UAT and business validation alongside an IT organisation
* Fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken. Italian, French or German language skills considered as a plus
* Experience in one or more other European retail energy markets — France, Germany or Italy in particular is highly appreciated
* Familiarity with a modern billing or CIS platform (SAP IS\-U or S/4HANA Utilities, Salesforce Energy \& Utilities Cloud, Gentrack, Hansen, Powercloud, Kraken or equivalent) is highly appreciated
* Experience in a start\-up or scale\-up environment, comfortable operating without an established playbook, is a plus
* Experience with collaboration and documentation tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Visio, Signavio or BPMN tools is an advantage

**GTM AI Applications Engineer**

**Context \& Impact:**  

This is a backfill role within Lansweeper's Revenue Operations team, built for someone who wants to spend meaningful time designing and building AI agents — not just maintaining systems. As a GTM Applications Engineer (AI Agents \& Integrations), you'll own the technical layer connecting our go\-to\-market application stack while actively identifying where AI can eliminate admin overhead, consolidate tooling, and automate GTM processes end\-to\-end. In this version of the role, you won't wait to be told where AI fits — you'll proactively find it, prototype it, and build it. The stack is your canvas; agents and skills are how you leave your mark.

**Challenge:**  

The main challenges you'll face are:

* **Breadth across platforms** — the GTM stack spans Gainsight, Gong, ZoomInfo, ZoomPhone, DocuSign, Salesforce, and more. You'll need to stay technically sharp and agile across all of them, adapting quickly as each platform evolves.
* **Agentic work at the frontier**. Building and orchestrating AI agents, whether in Workato, LangChain, Claude managed agents, or Salesforce Agentforce, is still emerging practice. You'll be working without a full playbook, which requires comfort with ambiguity and a bias for experimentation.
* **Self\-directed identification of AI opportunities** — rather than waiting for direction, you'll be expected to surface process gaps, evaluate their AI\-fit, and propose solutions. That requires both technical fluency and strong GTM process understanding.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own configuration, administration, and troubleshooting for the GTM application stack.
* Build and maintain integrations and data pipelines between GTM applications and Salesforce (e.g., Snowflake to Gainsight).
* Proactively identify GTM process areas where AI agents, automation, or AI\-assisted workflows can reduce admin burden, consolidate tooling, or improve data quality.
* Design, build, and deploy AI agents across the stack, using whichever platform fits the job (Workato, LangChain, Claude managed agents, Salesforce Agentforce, or equivalent), from scoping and prompt engineering through orchestration and into production.
* Monitor observability for deployed agents. Track what they do in production, catch failures or drift early, and iterate based on real usage.
* Build human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints for agentic workflows. Decide where an agent should escalate to a person instead of acting on its own, and design that approval or fallback path.
* Provide technical guidance and drive improvements across GTM systems projects, becoming the senior technical voice for AI integration within the stack.
* Take on lighter Salesforce administration and configuration tasks (fields, flows, permissions) alongside the Salesforce team.
* Evaluate and onboard new AI tools and GTM applications as the stack evolves, staying ahead of what's available and what's production\-ready.
* Partner with GTM Ops, Sales, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate process needs into scalable, AI\-augmented technical solutions.

**Key Requirements:**


Hard skills:

* 2–4 years in a technical applications, systems administration, or integrations role within a SaaS environment.
* Hands\-on experience building with AI agents or AI\-assisted tooling — production deployments, internal pilots, or substantive personal projects.
* Practical prompt engineering skills — able to design, test, and iterate prompts within AI platforms to produce reliable, production\-grade outputs.
* Hands\-on experience with integration/orchestration platforms such as Workato, Zapier, or similar. Most agent orchestration in this role runs through here.
* Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI agents on any agentic platform (examples: LangChain, Claude managed agents, Salesforce Agentforce, n8n). The platform matters less than a track record of shipping working agents.
* Basic fluency in agent observability (logging, monitoring, evaluating output quality) and in designing human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Strong troubleshooting instincts across integration, data\-sync, and AI workflow issues.


Soft skills:

* Self\-directed and proactive — identifies problems and improvement opportunities without needing to be pointed at them.
* Platform agility — comfortable context\-switching across many tools and adapting as each evolves.
* Structured communicator — translates technical AI concepts into business outcomes for GTM and leadership stakeholders.

**AI Specific Skills:**  

Lansweeper is an AI\-native company. AI is central here, not a side project. You'll design and deploy AI agents on whichever platform fits the job (Workato, LangChain, Claude managed agents, Salesforce Agentforce, and others), with real fluency in agent orchestration, observability, and human\-in\-the\-loop design. Prompt engineering stays core: you'll craft, test, and refine prompts in production contexts where reliability matters. Beyond building, you'll stay current on how AI tooling is evolving and bring forward\-looking recommendations to the team. What we care about is shipped, working agents, not loyalty to any one vendor.

**Team Info:**

* Secure agentic solutions and their extension points: tool integrations (MCP clients and servers), agent skills, and autonomous action boundaries such as scoped credentials, sandboxing, and human\-in\-the\-loop gates

### **Security Operations**

* Lead incident response for cloud and AI infrastructure security incidents

* Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for cloud\-native and AI systems

* Deep experience securing Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI systems

* Experience with secure multi\-tenant AI infrastructure
* Experience with privacy\-enhancing technologies for AI/ML (differential privacy, federated learning)

**Title**
 Director, Marketing
   

  

***Launching Trinzic***
 KBR’s Mission Technology Solutions business is expected to spin off in January 2027 and will operate as Trinzic, an independent, publicly traded company with 18,000 employees, a global presence with more than 60 locations, and more than $5 billion in revenue. This is a once\-in\-a career opportunity to help launch a global brand and create a lasting impression for a modern, tech\-forward national security company with customers like NASA, the U.S. Department of War (DoW), and the intelligence community. This position will ultimately become part of that new organization. It’s a unique opportunity to help shape Trinzic’s foundation, built on KBR’s proven track record and resources, and to help build the new company’s vision, culture, and future success.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Director, Marketing you will lead the strategy, development, and execution of the Trinzic brand across all audiences, channels, and experiences. This role is responsible for defining, elevating, and safeguarding the company's brand identity while driving creative excellence that strengthens market presence, builds engagement, and supports business growth.
   

  

 Following the launch of the Trinzic name, logo, tagline, and visual identity in July 2026, this leader will play a pivotal role in transforming a newly established brand into a recognized force within the national security and space markets. This is a unique opportunity to shape how customers, employees, investors, and industry partners experience and connect with the Trinzic brand from day one.
   

  

 We are seeking a strategic brand builder and exceptional storyteller who can translate complex technical capabilities, from astronaut training and space domain awareness to high energy lasers and systems integration, into compelling narratives, impactful campaigns, and distinctive creative experiences. This leader will oversee all brand and creative execution across digital, print, events, executive communications, investor materials, social media, internal communications, advertising, and other corporate assets.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in brand strategy and creative leadership gained within a leading agency, Fortune 500 organization, top\-tier defense contractor, or similarly complex environment. Success will be measured through brand awareness, audience engagement, employee adoption, campaign performance, and overall contribution to corporate growth objectives.
   

  

**This role will be based out of the Arlington, VA office and will be a hybrid position.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Brand Strategy \& Governance**
* Lead the development and execution of the company's global brand strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and growth priorities.
* Drive brand adoption across global markets, balancing consistency in messaging and identity with the unique needs of local regions.
* Serve as one of the leaders responsible for establishing, scaling, and protecting the Trinzic brand during its first years as an independent public company.
* Establish and maintain brand governance, standards, guidelines, and approval processes across the organization.
* Drive the evolution of the brand positioning, voice, and value proposition to strengthen market differentiation and awareness.


**Creative Leadership \& Content Development**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing creative team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
* Oversee the development of creative assets and campaigns across digital, print, video, social media, events, executive communications, and other marketing channels.

* Direct creative strategy and execution for major campaigns, launches, internal and customer programs, leadership initiatives, and corporate events.
* Oversee all brand execution and deliverables from graphics, videos, tradeshow booths, PowerPoint presentations, digital brochures, swag, investor relations materials, the company website, newsletters, social media, executive communications, internal intranet sites, advertising, signage, and all other company assets.


**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Regularly interact with executive leadership, including providing strategic counsel to the CEO and senior leadership team on brand, reputation, and market positioning.
* Collaborate closely with communications, digital marketing, business development, human resources, and external partners to deliver integrated marketing programs.
* Partner with our People Partners and Talent Acquisition to strengthen employer branding, recruitment marketing, and employee engagement initiatives that enhance Trinzic's ability to attract and retain top talent.
* Present brand strategies, campaign recommendations, and creative concepts to executive leadership.
* Partner with Communications to support reputation management, issues preparedness, and stakeholder communications during critical business events.


**Agency \& Resource Management**
* Lead relationships with external vendors and production agencies.
* Manage budgets, agency performance, and resource allocation to ensure effective execution and return on investment.
* Evaluate and implement best practices, tools, and processes that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the creative function.


**Insights \& Performance Measurement**
* Leverage market research, competitive intelligence, and audience insights to inform branding and creative decisions.
* Establish key performance indicators and measurement frameworks to evaluate brand health and campaign effectiveness.
* Monitor performance metrics and recommend optimizations to strengthen engagement, awareness, and business impact.
* Stay informed on emerging marketing, branding, and design trends to continuously advance the organization's capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, Journalism, Design, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of progressive marketing, branding, advertising, or communications experience.
* 5\+ years of people leadership experience, including managing, developing, and mentoring creative, marketing, or brand teams in both in\-person and remote work environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise\-level brand strategy and creative development initiatives.
* Experience managing external agencies, creative partners, vendors, and production resources.
* Proven success developing and implementing brand frameworks, visual identity systems, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Experience working within a complex, matrixed organization with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support business priorities, global brand initiatives, events, and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Must be a U.S. citizen


**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong creative judgment with a demonstrated understanding of design principles, content development, and audience engagement.
* Outstanding leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team\-building skills.
* Ability to influence and build consensus across executive leadership and cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Strong strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to balance long\-term brand strategy with short\-term business priorities.
* Experience utilizing data, analytics, and customer insights to drive marketing decisions.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: Production Director
description:
**ATMOSPHERE CHURCH**

**Production Director**

*Build what's next in a church that resources good ideas.*

**Location**

Westlake Village, California

**Schedule**

Full\-time, including Sundays and special events

**Salary**

$80,000 – $100,000, plus potential annual bonus

**Benefits**

Full medical paid by the church, dental, vision, generous PTO

**Reports To**

the Worship Pastor

**We believe excellent technology doesn't compete with the move of God – it clears the way for it.** A room where the mix is right, the lights serve the moment, and nothing breaks is a room where nobody is thinking about the tech at all. That's the job. We're looking for a Production Director who is genuinely excellent at the craft, hungry to build something rather than maintain it, and who understands that every fader and fixture exists to help people meet Jesus.

If you've been in a room where your ideas got answered with “no budget” or “we've always done it this way,” this is a different kind of room. Innovation here is welcomed, resourced, and expected.

**The Church**

Atmosphere Church is a growing church in Westlake Village, California, in the Conejo Valley just outside Los Angeles.

* Weekly attendance: 2000 across 3Sunday gatherings
* Auditorium: 500seats, current system installed 2024
* Online: 500 weekly views through Atmosphere Online
* Production team: 20 volunteers
* Beyond Sundays: young adult and youth gatherings, worship nights, connect nights, Serve Days, Easter and Christmas Eve

**What You'll Own**

You are the person accountable for what the room feels like. Specifically:

* **The Sunday experience.** Audio, lighting, video, and screens across every gathering – consistently excellent, week after week, with no drama and no surprises.
* **A team, not a schedule.** A volunteer production team that is recruited, genuinely trained (off\-platform, never during a live gathering), scheduled at least a month out, and actually known and cared for. You'll decide how that care happens; we'll measure whether people stay, grow, and want to bring their friends.
* **The technical environment.** System health, maintenance, upgrade planning, and the recommendations that shape where we invest next. You'll own an annual production budget and have a real seat in capital decisions.
* **Atmosphere Online.** The streaming and post\-service experience – quality, reliability, and the handoff of online guests to people who can follow up with them.
* **Creative partnership.** Working alongside the Worship Pastor, Creative team, and Next Gen Worship Director so that service elements are planned, built, and executed together rather than handed off at the last minute.
* **What comes next.** Bringing us ideas we haven't thought of yet – in immersive audio, lighting design, video storytelling, live automation, IMAG, AI\-assisted workflows, whatever serves the moment. We would rather resource a good idea than protect a comfortable status quo.

**Your First Year**

Here's what we'd celebrate twelve months in:

* **Sundays are boringly excellent.** No week where the tech is what people remember.
* **The team has depth.** Every critical position has at least two trained, confident volunteers – so no single person is a point of failure, including you.
* **There's a plan on paper.** A documented three\-year technical roadmap: what we have, what's aging, what we invest in and when.
* **Something new happened.** At least one thing we do on a Sunday is something we couldn't do the year before, and you're the reason.

**Who You Are**

* **5\+ years in live production** – church, touring, corporate events, or broadcast – with at least 2 years leading a team. If your background is commercial and this would be your first church role, we want to talk to you.
* **A genuine craftsperson.** You have opinions about gain structure and gel choices, and you can defend them.
* **A builder of people.** You'd rather train a nervous volunteer into a confident one than run every service yourself. Your best measure of success is how well the room runs when you're not in it.
* **Calm when it counts.** Something will fail thirty seconds before a set. You get quieter, not louder.
* **A systems thinker.** You document, label, plan ahead, and follow through. The booth you leave behind is one the next person can walk into.
* **Comfortable with people, not just gear.** This role is deeply relational – volunteers, staff, and members, every week.

**Technical Environment**

**You should be strong in:**

* A large\-format digital audio console (ours are Allen \& Heath Avantis with Waves, and SQ7\)
* ProPresenter 7
* Multi\-camera switching and IMAG (Blackmagic ATEM)
* Networked audio and control fundamentals – Dante and/or Q\-SYS

**Our environment also includes — and we'll happily train the right person on anything here they haven't touched:**

*Dante Level 2 · Q\-SYS · ETC Ion XE 20 (2K) · LightKey · Resi (streaming) · Ableton Live · Logic Pro · Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop) · Planning Center · Canva*

We're far more interested in how fast you learn a new system than in whether you've already used ours.

**Faith and Character**

This is a ministry role, and the technical excellence is in service of something. We're looking for someone who brings:

* A consistent, growing personal relationship with Jesus Christ
* Spiritual maturity and character consistent with the biblical qualifications for church leadership
* Sensitivity to the Holy Spirit in how you lead and serve
* Genuine alignment with the vision, theology, and expression of Atmosphere Church
* A heart that puts people over tasks, and humility that serves rather than performs

**Our core values, which we actually use:** Love God · Love People · Pursue Excellence · Choose Joy

This position is a full participant in the life of the church – attending a Sunday gathering weekly, belonging to a Life Group, and growing in the Word alongside the rest of our staff.

**The Rhythm of the Role**

We'd rather be straight with you than surprise you later:

* **Sundays are the job.** This is a Sunday\-facing role with a mid\-week rhythm; your weekend is our Monday.
* **Seasons peak.** Easter, Christmas Eve, retreats, worship nights, and Serve Days are all\-in weekends for our whole staff.
* **About 40–45 hours in a normal week,** more in a peak one — and we expect you to take real time off in the valleys. Burning out our director is not a win for anybody.
* **Occasional travel** for conferences and church\-network intensives, because we want you sharpening, not just spending.
* **Some lifting.** Occasionally up to 50 lbs.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* **Salary:** $80,000 – $100,000, depending on experience, with potential for an annual bonus
* **Health:** Full medical coverage paid by the church; dental and vision included
* **Time off:** 20 vacation days per year (up to 6 may be Sundays), plus the weekdays between Christmas and New Year's, plus 12 sick days
* **Equipment:** Your choice of laptop or iPad
* **Development:** Conference and training budget – we invest in you staying current
* **Reports to:** the Worship Pastor
* **Relocation:** Assistance available / Happy to discuss

**How to Apply**

Send the following to Michael Girgis at mgirgis@atmosphere.church:

* **Your resume.**
* **A reel or portfolio link** – a service you mixed, a video you cut, a lighting look you designed, a room you built. Two minutes is plenty. Show us your work.
* **A short answer** (written or a two\-minute video, your call): Tell us about a time technology got out of the way and something happened in a room. What did you do to make that possible?

**Our process:** phone conversation **→\* on\-site visit and technical conversation** →\* a Sunday with us, paid. We'll keep you posted on where you stand at every step, and we aim to move from first call to decision within *f*our weeks.

***We're not looking for someone to run our booth. We're looking for someone to build what's next.***

Atmosphere Church · Westlake Village, CA ·

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Studio Production Assistant
description:
MOO brings brands to life in a sustainable way, with a range of remarkable print and merchandise products. We combine design, technology, manufacturing and service, so that people can connect in memorable ways. Not online but out there, in real life.

We started in 2004\. Since then we’ve built an award\-winning and much\-loved brand, with customer satisfaction and Trustpilot ratings that make most businesses want to give up and hire an army of review bots. We’ve got half a million customers, mostly small and medium businesses in North America, the UK, and Europe – businesses that, like us, get all excited about putting something real and beautiful into people’s hands. Does that make us nerds? Probably, and we’re ok with that.

We’ve been given the highest business award in Britain, ‘The Queen’s Award for Enterprise’. Backed by venture capital, we’re part of Tech Nation’s ‘Future Fifty’, recently passing $1bn in lifetime revenue, and featuring in the Guardian’s top 10 UK start\-ups list. Ok, we’ll stop bragging now.

Today, we’re more than 400 people with our global HQ in London, UK, while we also have premises in Dagenham. In the US, you’ll find us in Boston, MA, as well as East Providence, RI and Denver, CO and with our most recent office expansion in Cape Town South Africa.  

MOO set out to shake up the world of print back in 2006\. And we’ve come a long way since. Today we’re a 400 \+ strong team (we’re thinking of getting matching jackets) who create print and digital products for companies of all sizes – from Google and AirBnB to the guy who makes those amazing prints you found at a craft fair.
  

  

At MOO, we care about great design. We’re a team of makers, thinkers, and creators helping businesses of all sizes look their absolute best through beautiful print and digital products.

Our Creative Team is expanding, and we have a great opportunity for a Studio Production Assistant to join our (award winning) Creative team working in our London office reporting to our Lead Photographer.  

  

Photography \& Video are integral parts of the MOO brand and the success of our product marketing. If you have an eagerness to learn, a knack for organization, and a passion for production, you will fit right in. You will play a crucial support role in ensuring our in\-house shoots run smoothly and our studio is well\-maintained.  

  

We’re making new and exciting things – and we could really do with your help.
### **The person we want**

* You will assist the wider production team on everything from slick product showcases, e\-commerce product photography shoots, social media campaigns to internal culture videos, while developing your own production and post\-production skills.
* You’ll have a real passion for photography, design and communication, and a genuine desire to do brilliant work.
* Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
* Proactive and hands on attitude, keen to learn in a fast paced creative environment.
* Strong communication skills.
* Familiarity with studio equipment, basic lighting setups, and audio recording gear.
* A can\-do attitude with the ability to think on your feet, troubleshoot minor technical issues on set, and anticipate the needs of the production team.

Previous experience in a creative studio or design environment would be beneficial (studio assistant or runner role).  
* 

### **Responsibilities**

* Help maintain the studio: Organise, inventory, and prep cameras, lighting, and audio equipment for upcoming shoots.
* Ensure the studio space is clean, safe, and ready for use.
* Assist in ensuring props/wardrobe are easily accessible, organised and maintained.
* Prepare products for shoots, unboxing and ensuring we have everything we need to start.
* Support the production team with coordinating schedules, basic call sheets, talent, and location setups.
* Assist on\-set with basic lighting setups, audio monitoring, and acting as general support (running) for camera operators and directors.
* Aid the production team in following and upholding MOO’s brand style guidelines to ensure consistent, on\-brand photography that is technically and aesthetically remarkable.
* File management where needed of imagery using Google Drive.

### **Nice To Have's**

* Experience using Adobe Creative Suite and Figma is desirable but not essential.

**What’s it like to work at MOO?**
MOO’s the kind of workplace where you can really be yourself. Dye your hair purple. Hit the sofa with your laptop. Whatever helps you feel comfortable and happy at work. title: Government Contracts Counsel
description:
We believe that by equipping researchers with rapid insights and providers with tailored, on\-demand data, we can help people lead better, healthier lives. At Digital Infuzion, we harness innovative healthcare solutions and cutting\-edge bioinformatics to make meaningful impacts in patient care.  

  

Our team thrives in a creative, open, and growth\-oriented environment, guided by our core values:  

**Outcomes First:** Focusing on what matters most and making timely, informed decisions.  

**Innovative:** Embracing creativity and continuous improvement to drive novel solutions.  

**Radical Candor:** Communicating openly and honestly, balancing direct feedback with genuine care.  

**Never Satisfied:** Pursuing excellence and continuous growth beyond the status quo.  

**Resilient:** Adapting and persevering through challenges, turning obstacles into opportunities.  

  

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to improve healthcare and want to work in an environment that values innovation and collaboration, we may have just the opportunity for you.  

  

**Position Overview:**  

The Government Contracts Counsel serves as Digital Infuzion, LLC’s principal attorney for federal Government contracting and provides dedicated legal support to the Director of Contracts and Contracts Management personnel. The role focuses on legal matters arising throughout the federal contracting lifecycle, including prime contracts, subcontracts, modifications, teaming and strategic\-partnering arrangements, proposal matters, regulatory requirements, and contract\-related risk. The position works closely with Contracts Management, Growth/Business Development, Technical Operations, Finance, and Corporate Counsel to provide practical, business\-oriented legal guidance while enabling efficient contract execution and appropriate risk management.  

  

**Work Environment:**  

This position operates primarily in a professional office and remote\-work environment and requires frequent interaction with internal personnel, customers, business partners, Government personnel and external advisors. The position may occasionally require travel or participation in meetings outside normal business hours based on business needs.  

  

**Responsibilities:*** Draft, review, analyze and negotiate agreements and instruments associated with the federal contracting lifecycle, including prime contracts, subcontracts and modifications, teaming agreements, nondisclosure agreements, consulting agreements, letters of authorization and related documents.
* Advise regarding federal Government contracting requirements, including the FAR, applicable agency supplements, and contractual requirements applicable to Company prime contracts and subcontracts.
* Analyze Government contract modifications, new or revised regulatory clauses and developments, and advise regarding their effect on existing contracts, subcontracts and required flow\-downs.
* Provide the Contracts Management team with legal interpretation, negotiation support, regulatory guidance and escalation support for complex, sensitive or non\-routine matters.
* Lead or support subcontract negotiations and other contract negotiations requiring legal judgment, including review of risk allocation, indemnification, limitation of liability, intellectual property, data rights, confidentiality, compliance and other material legal terms.
* In collaboration with the Director of Contracts, communicate with Government Contracting Officers and other Government personnel regarding contractual and legal matters when appropriate and coordinate those communications with program personnel.
* Provide legal support for proposal and business\-development activities, including teaming, workshare provisions, intellectual property and data rights issues, and other proposal\-related legal risks.
* Advise regarding federal small\-business and strategic\-partnering matters, including teaming arrangements, joint ventures, mentor\-protege relationships and related SBA requirements.
* Provide legal support on significant prime\-contract and subcontract matters when an issue presents heightened legal or business risk.
* Partner with Corporate Counsel on matters that extend beyond Government contracting or implicate broader enterprise legal issues, including employment, privacy, cybersecurity, corporate governance, insurance, disputes and other specialized areas.
* Interact with Government personnel, customers, prime contractors, subcontractors, teaming partners, vendors, consultants and outside attorneys.
* Identify opportunities to improve contracting processes, templates, playbooks, tools, documentation, controls and escalation procedures in collaboration with the Director of Contracts.
* Identify opportunities to responsibly apply AI, automation, and other technologies to contract review, legal research, drafting, knowledge management, and contracting workflows.

  

**Competencies and Traits:*** Excellent contract drafting, review and negotiation skills, with particular strength in federal Government contracting.
* Strong knowledge of the FAR, federal procurement requirements, flow\-down obligations and Government\-contract risk allocation.
* Sound legal and business judgment with an Outcomes First approach focused on practical solutions and appropriate risk management.
* Ability to communicate complex legal and regulatory requirements clearly to contracts professionals and other non\-lawyers.
* Radical Candor in communicating legal advice clearly, directly and constructively.
* Innovative and resourceful problem\-solving and a Never Satisfied mindset toward continuous improvement.
* High degree of professional judgment, discretion and integrity; ability to manage competing priorities and time\-sensitive negotiations.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:*** Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
* Active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
* Substantial relevant legal experience in business and contracting law, with meaningful experience (five years) involving federal Government contracting.
* Prior in\-house legal experience with a federal Government contractor
* Significant experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating subcontracts and other business agreements.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the FAR and federal procurement requirements.
* Experience advising on federal small\-business programs, teaming arrangements, joint ventures and mentor\-protege relationships
* Experience with intellectual property and data\-rights issues in Government contracting.
* Strong written, oral, analytical and negotiation skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience with HHS/NIH contracting, health IT, clinical research, life sciences or other regulated technology environments.
* Experience evaluating and responsibly using AI\-enabled and emerging technologies to enhance legal research, contract review, drafting, and analysis, while validating outputs and maintaining confidentiality, accuracy, professional judgment, and accountability.
* Familiarity with the legal, ethical, privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual\-property, and data\-governance considerations associated with acquiring or deploying AI solutions in the public sector.

The decision on granting reasonable accommodation will be made on a case\-by\-case basis.**

title: Senior Brand and Content Marketer
description:
The Senior Brand and Content Marketer owns Clarify Health’s point of view and every word that carries it to market. The role produces thought leadership, brand narrative, campaign content, and sales enablement material, and directs the freelance creative resources that support it.



The role reports to the Head of Marketing and works alongside the Director, Growth Marketing, who owns campaign orchestration, account\-based programs, and partnership with the field. Marketing operations and digital channels are being built out now, so this person will help shape how the work reaches its audience rather than inheriting a finished system. This is a role for someone who wants to establish a function, not maintain one.



Clarify Health builds the data foundation that health systems and payers use to make network decisions, mapping more than 300 million lives and 20 billion data points through the Clarify Atlas Platform. Clarify Meridian applies that foundation as a discipline system for referral network excellence, helping health systems keep high\-quality, strategically aligned patient volume inside their networks across more than 70 payment models. We have the evidence to explain what works in that market. What we do not yet have is a consistent voice putting it in front of the strategy and finance leaders who make the decisions.



This role will help elevate Clarify brand perception and recognition through consistent and credible content and messaging, so that health system leaders recognize Clarify’s perspective before a sales conversation starts.



### **The role**



Where we need you most: thought leadership, campaign and sales enablement content. The other areas below matter, but those two are why we are opening this role. The strongest candidates will have built a brand story and equipped a field team with materials they need across the entire sales process.


* Thought leadership and brand narrative. Develop and sustain the perspective Clarify takes to market through executive\-bylined articles, market commentary, and research\-backed points of view. Maintain a publishing calendar and hold its cadence.
* Campaign content. Produce landing page copy, email sequences, nurture track copy, ad copy, and blog content for every campaign.
* Sales enablement content. Build and maintain battlecards, case studies, one\-pagers, white papers, and pitch narrative, and support regional vice presidents directly on prospecting materials.
* Brand story and messaging consistency. Carry the narrative across every external asset, working from positioning and messaging pillars set by the Head of Marketing.
* Social content and publishing. Own the social calendar, publishing, and executive social presence.
* Website copy. Own the words on the site and partner with the Director, Growth Marketing on structure, conversion paths, and SEO briefs.
* Creative direction. Provide direction for occasional freelance design, including briefs, quality control, and delivery management.
* Media partnership. Supply the substance the contract PR resource places with media, and support award and recognition submissions.


What success looks like


* In the first 90 days. You have absorbed the positioning and messaging pillars, taken over the publishing calendar, and refreshed the core sales enablement set: battlecards, the pitch narrative, and two case studies.
* By six months. A thought leadership cadence is running at one executive\-bylined piece per month and one long\-form piece per quarter. Campaign content ships on the marketing calendar without slipping.
* By twelve months.That cadence has held for four consecutive quarters. The regional vice presidents reach for your content in live deals, and Clarify’s point of view is recognizable to health system strategy leaders.
### **What we are looking for**



Required qualifications


* Four to six years in B2B content marketing, brand, or communications.
* A portfolio of published work carrying an executive or organizational voice. We will ask for three samples and a short written note on what you specifically contributed to each. This is our primary screen, so please have it ready when you apply.
* Direct experience marketing in healthcare, health technology, or another regulated industry, with demonstrated understanding of the buyer and the compliance constraints.


Preferred qualifications


* Long\-form healthcare content experience, including white papers, research\-backed reports, or original analysis.
* Experience ghostwriting for an executive and sustaining a consistent voice over time.
* Sales enablement experience, particularly in a company where the field owns prospecting.
* Experience briefing and directing designers, and working knowledge of a marketing automation platform as a content contributor rather than an administrator.
### **What we offer you**


* Competitive compensation (base \+ bonus \+ equity)
* Quality health insurance
* Traditional 401(k) plan
* Vision, dental, disability, and life insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Generous PTO
* Flexibility
* Monthly work\-from\-home stipend
* Remote friendly
* A collaborative workplace that will challenge you and celebrate your work
* A chance to learn with and from interesting and enthusiastic colleagues
$117,000 \- $135,000 a year

Don't meet every single requirement? At Clarify we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!


*We believe that a happy, diverse, and impact\-driven team is critical to our mission of transforming healthcare. title: Director of Operations
description:
***Link to apply listed at the bottom of this Job Description. Only applications submitted through this link will be considered.***

**WHO WE ARE**

Client Accelerators is a performance marketing agency that helps clients scale through media buying, appointment setting, and data\-driven growth strategy. We are building the operating system of a modern agency, one where a single source of truth exists for every data type, automation carries the load that manual work used to, and success is a function of the system rather than any one person maintaining it.

Client Accelerators is a paid advertising agency that specializes in Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Google Search, and Google Display ads. The agency officially launched back in 2018\. Since then, we’ve grown to over 50 clients and cumulatively spend over $40 million a year in ad spend for our clients.

Our main focus is on the High\-Ticket Funnel Industry. We’ve crafted a unique set of strategies that scale ads and outperform our competitors from both a media buying perspective and a creative building perspective. Since we’ve focused on funnel marketing, these strategies are fine\-tuned to the needs and complications of our clients before we even meet them.

Client Accelerators is located in Westfield, NJ, where we have an inhouse \+remote team of 32 who enjoys crushing our competition with hyper\-focused, data\-driven marketing strategies. While we support each other as challenges arise, there is always room for a little friendly competition. Whether we’re fighting to hit the best numbers for our clients, or showing each other up in a Friday night game of ping\-pong, we are always working towards being the best we can.

Our Core Values are:

* **We are Problem Solvers**: If you spot a problem in our company or a client’s company, provide a solution. There’s millions of problems, and not as many problem solvers, be the solution.
* **Open Source Code**: We share what’s working with everyone
* **Empty The Bucket**: If you just spent two hours cleaning your car, you put all of the cleaning materials away, but you notice you missed a spot, you go back, get everything back out, and finish the job.
* **We’re a ‘TEAM’ not a Family**: Leaders at CA, hire, develop, and cut smartly, so we have Superstars at every position. We only work with the best at their craft.
* **Ownership Thinking**: Extreme ownership in everything you do. Going out of your way to make sure your actions and the actions of your peers are in the best interest of the company
* **Being The Best**: Mastering your domain so you’re the best in the world at it

**\*\*If our culture and mission does not resonate with you, please do not bother applying.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

The Client Accelerators team is looking for a seasoned, multifaceted Director of Operations who has built and scaled an agency before and is not learning on the job. This is a critical leadership role for an operator who can walk into fragmented systems, an informal team culture, and a robust amount of data, and see that as the job rather than the obstacle.

You will build the dashboards, financial controls, team cadences, and people systems that let the business scale while freeing the CEO to focus on his zone of genius. Your first priority is to reduce the load that currently flows through the founder by building the structure that makes escalation to him the exception rather than the rule. You do this not by taking tasks from him, but by building the systems that make the operation run without him. The application code word is EMPOWER. The Director of Operations is a highly skilled strategic thinker who anticipates and solves problems in a self\-directed way, and who empowers and builds a team around them to move fast while maintaining culture and quality.

This role will lead Client Accelerators through a chapter of rapid growth and transition in close collaboration with the CEO. This is a remote position. Employment type is 1099 for the 90 Day Probationary and the option to pivot to W2 after. Given the critical nature of this role, we host a rigorous, 4\-part application process.

**WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE UNIQUE**

You will be stepping into a business with real financial ambition and the early instinct to be a data\-driven, automated agency, but one that still runs on a layer of manual spreadsheets, disconnected systems, and institutional knowledge concentrated in one person. Your mandate is to turn that instinct into infrastructure.

Your success will be measured by one ultimate outcome: building an operation where the CEO can step out of day\-to\-day operations, finance, and team management, and the business runs as a self\-managing machine. You will establish clear 30/60/90/180\-day milestones, operating cadences, and decision\-making frameworks that make the strategic direction visible at every level of the organization.

This role requires someone who earns authority rather than assumes it. You will not receive a warm welcome by default, and you will not overcome skepticism with enthusiasm. You will earn trust through consistent structure, clear KPIs, and results that speak before you do.

**RESPONSIBILITIES (TASKS ASSOCIATED WITH THE ROLE):**

**Strategic Leadership \& Vision Execution**

* Work closely with the CEO to actualize the company vision and cascade it into daily accountability
* Translate high\-level goals into actionable strategic plans with clear initiatives, owners, deadlines, and OKRs
* Serve as the glue that holds departments together, ensuring cohesion and alignment across the business
* Provide clear, high\-level updates to ownership on operations and strategic initiatives

**Systems, Automation \& Single Source of Truth**

* Build an environment where a single source of truth exists for every data type and manual input is the exception
* Evaluate the tool stack, identify what should be automated, and sequence the build prioritization
* Hold the line on manual processes that belong in the backlog, and know the difference between a durable automation and a fragile one
* Ensure no critical process lives only in someone's head through documented SOPs and systems

**Financial \& Operational Oversight**

* Own the P\&L with the discipline of a CFO, managing OPEX actively as a lever rather than a line on a report
* Read a messy P\&L, identify the distortions, and produce a clean financial view leadership can act on
* Hold OPEX stable or compress it as a percentage of revenue as growth accelerates, rather than hiring ahead of systems
* Convert multi\-tab dashboards and complex operational data into one\-page views a leadership team can decide from

**Team Leadership \& Development**

* Lead a fully remote, predominantly international team, establishing formal accountability without dismantling the informal relationships that make the team run
* Recruit, manage, promote, and train an effective team, and manage the evolving org chart and culture
* Build leadership layers where they do not yet exist, developing people promoted from execution roles into genuine leaders
* Hold department heads and team members accountable to outcomes, and own the difficult conversations that maintain that accountability

**REQUIREMENTS (EXPECTED PROFICIENCIES):**

**Experience Requirements (Non\-Negotiable)**

* You have personally built and scaled an agency from early growth stage through to eight figures, from fragmented systems and unclear roles to a running machine
* You own P\&L with CFO\-level discipline and understand OPEX deeply as a lever you manage actively, including reading a messy P\&L and producing a clean financial view
* You have built AI and automation into the daily operating rhythm of a growth\-stage company, not treated them as future\-state aspirations
* You have led fully remote, predominantly international teams as your standard operating environment, and understand the cultural dynamics and informal power structures that develop over time
* You have built leadership layers in companies that did not have them, and developed execution\-level people into leaders

**Core Competencies**

* Converting complexity into clarity: taking a wall of KPI data or a complex operational picture and producing a one\-page view a leadership team can act on
* Systems thinking to design scalable processes and automations that do not depend on founder involvement
* Data and KPI management to establish, track, and optimize meaningful metrics across every level of the business
* Change management to roll out new standards, systems, and expectations to a team that has experienced inconsistent structure
* Outcome\-based management philosophy rather than input or time\-tracking approaches

**Critical Soft Skills (Deal\-Breakers)**

* You earn authority through consistency and delivered results, and establish credibility before you ask for it
* You push back with data, not deference. You can sit across from the CEO, tell him his instinct is wrong, and back it with a better plan, without being a yes\-person or a passive order\-taker
* You cascade vision into daily accountability, translating strategic direction into goals, owners, deadlines, and checkpoints visible at every level
* You process information quickly, make decisions under incomplete data, and execute without needing permission for every move
* You have cultural intelligence in networked remote teams, earning trust across cultural lines and building on top of existing relationships rather than overriding them

**Technical Requirements**

* Exceptional attention to detail, time\-management, and organizational skills
* Comfortable working 100% remotely and managing distributed, international teams across multiple time zones
* Self\-starter who manages schedule, team, and deadlines without direct supervision
* Data\-driven decision maker able to analyze data and make critical choices based on evidence
* Candid and direct communicator with strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills in English
* Ability to maintain core collaboration hours between 9:30am to 6:00pm EST.

**Mindset \& Cultural Fit**

* You are a builder, not a manager of the status quo. You are genuinely excited by a performance marketing agency scaling a remote international team with real financial ambition
* You hold yourself to the highest standards of performance and are resilient in the face of obstacles or failure
* You thrive in fast\-changing environments and are comfortable with ambiguity during periods of rapid transformation
* You are not looking for a stable corporate operations role. You are looking for something to build

**BENEFITS**

* Compensation: $120,000 to $140,000 commensurate with experience \+ bonus structure tied to growth of the organization.
* Employment type is 1099 for the 90 Day Probationary and the option to pivot to W2 after
* Unlimited PTO
* Standard US Holidays are observed for US based team members
* Professional Development: This role will be supported by an external Ops program that includes Ops mentorship, community, and live coaching.

**HOW TO APPLY**

If you are interested in this position, please submit an application at the following link.

**https://recruiterflow.com/db\_5f712a22c33a3d8ff14e412f5e6ab747/jobs/44**

Our team will review your application and get back to you shortly. We look forward to hearing from you!

***DISCLAIMER:***

*Spyglass Ops is an authorized representative of Client Accelerators. We are an Operations Hiring Agency, working on behalf of startup businesses to find and hire Operations Positions. All of our roles are full\-time, salaried, leadership positions within growing business. We also filter the businesses we work with, to ensure they provide long\-term positions, growth opportunities, and a strong working environment / culture. Our company qualifies and interviews candidates, then connects finalists with our clients for final interviews and job offers. Our highest priority is creating win\-win matches for both our candidates and clients.*
